name: ihateposting
description: Schedule and publish to 14 social networks from Grok Build: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, Tumblr and Slack, through the hosted iHatePosting MCP server. You sign in with your iHatePosting account from /mcps (select it and press i); there is no key to set.
